title: ModRisk-MultiNet: code and derived data for the corrected R2 pair-level classification
description: Versioned analysis code, frozen non-restricted genetic-correlation result tables, and the corrected R2 derived pair-level classification for a 71-disease multimorbidity network. The R2 repair separates FDR-significant signed baseline-to-joint differences, direction of absolute genetic-correlation magnitude change, and residual significance. No GWAS, LDSC, partialLDSC, joint-conditioning, MVMR, or MR-AHC estimates were rerun or changed. Restricted third-party GWAS files are not included.
